app.name: Senti
app.tagline: A map of paths and trails enriched by people's memories.

cattura.sottotitolo: Press the button and let the person remember out loud. Details come afterwards: don't interrupt the story.
cattura.registro: Everything you publish is recorded under your name, even when you choose to stay anonymous: others see Anonymous voice, the ledger knows it is you. Today the ledger is worth recognition. If the platform ever generates revenue, the ledger is the basis on which it gets shared. We promise no figures: we promise the count is transparent and that nobody can erase it.

riascolto.durata: Recording of {durata}. Listen back before continuing.

campi.nota: A line or two to find it again
campi.notaAiuto: These are your words, not the witness's: they only help you find the memory again. The voice stays the original.

consenso.etichetta: The person speaking has consented to publishing this memory.
consenso.spiegazione: Without consent the memory stays private: nobody sees it, and it is never transcribed.
consenso.obbligatorio: The speaker's consent is required before saving.

coda.inInvio: {n, plural, one {# memory being sent…} other {# memories being sent…}}
coda.attesaRete: {n, plural, one {# memory waiting for network} other {# memories waiting for network}}

limiti.durataMassima: Up to {minuti} minutes: tell one episode at a time.
limiti.rimanentiMese: {n, plural, =0 {no memories left this month} one {# memory left this month} other {# memories left this month}}
limiti.fermataAutomatica: Recording stopped by itself at {minuti} minutes. What you recorded is safe: if the story continues, save this one and record another.
limiti.quotaEsaurita: You have used up this month's memories. Come back next month.

salvata.offline: It is safe on your phone. It will send itself as soon as the network is back.

dichiarazione.domanda: Are the story and the voice yours or someone else's?
dichiarazione.confermaMia: This is my story and it is true as far as I know; I accept that other users listen to it and read it.
dichiarazione.avvisoTerzi: You may publish another person's story ONLY if you have their permission. You are responsible for having obtained it. The platform is not liable for anything published without the permission of the person involved.
dichiarazione.hoPermesso: I have this person's permission to publish their story.
dichiarazione.consensoVoce: This person accepts that their voice is published and listened to.
dichiarazione.veridicita: The story is true as far as I know.

mappa.suggerimentoToccoLungo: Press and hold on the map to mark another point

vicini.titolo: Did you mean one of these?
vicini.spiegazione: There is already a place marked nearby. If it is the same one, go back and use it: two entries for the same spot split its memories in two.

errori.gpsNonDisponibile: This device does not provide a location.
errori.gpsNegato: I cannot read your location. Check permissions.

origine.automatica: Automatically transcribed text, may contain errors.
origine.raccoglitore: Note by whoever collected the memory — not the witness's words.

vuoto.testo: No memories and no events within range of this point. You can be the first voice to tell it.

contesto.nota: Context added by the platform, not part of the testimony.

condividi.qrIstruzione: Scan the code to open Senti

demo.scegli: Test mode: choose who you are

cura.nonCuratrice: This page is for curators. In test mode, choose "Curatrice" from the selector at the bottom.
cura.conteggio: {n, plural, one {# memory waiting} other {# memories waiting}}

io.citazioniNota: how many times your memories are cited in the narratives
io.unicaVoceNota: places where you are the only witness
io.registroNota: The ledger is worth recognition. If the platform ever generates revenue, it is the basis on which it gets shared. The count is transparent and nobody can erase it.
io.privacyNota: Only numbers: you don't know who voted or visited, and nobody knows about you.

vuoto.intro: You haven't told anything yet. But you are not a screen of zeros.
vuoto.vicino: is near you and has no memories yet. You could be its first voice.
vuoto.generico: There is a place, out there, still waiting for its first voice.

intro.comeFunziona: Senti is a map of memories. Each person tells their own story tied to a place, and together the stories give voice to the land.
intro.anonimo: You can choose to stay anonymous: others won't see your name, but the system will. It's how your contributions are recognised and kept in the ledger.
intro.regola: Tell your own story and you are responsible for it. To publish someone else's, you must have their permission.
intro.prova: Senti is in trial and is built with the help of artificial intelligence: it may contain errors or behave unexpectedly. Use it keeping that in mind.

patto.testo: Before you start, take a look at the Terms of use and the Privacy notice. The Terms are accepted once; the Privacy notice explains how we handle your data.
patto.accetto: I accept the Terms and have read the Privacy notice

cookie.testo: We use technical cookies, needed to run the app and always on. Only if you want, we also use statistics cookies to understand how the app is used. You can change your mind anytime in settings.

piepagina.prova: Trial version, built with the help of AI: it may contain errors.

cookie.tecnici: Technical cookies are always on: they run the app and cannot be turned off.
cookie.statistiche: Enable statistics cookies (to understand how the app is used)

motivi.senza_permesso: Published without the involved person's permission
